subjects: an empty leather executive chair pushed back from a wooden desk

styles.A_engraving: Vintage editorial newspaper illustration of {s}. Fine crosshatched black ink linework with soft hand-colored washes of faded oxblood red and warm sepia, like a hand-tinted engraving. Centered on blank cream paper with wide empty margins, quiet and detailed.
styles.B_pencil: {S}, drawn in colored pencil over loose black ink cross-hatching, warm hand-shaded tones of rust, ochre and charcoal, visible directional pencil strokes and paper tooth. Magazine portrait-illustration style, single subject centered on plain unmarked cream paper.
styles.C_stipple: {S}, rendered as a newspaper hedcut: dense black ink stippling and fine hatching, with a single soft wash of faded red. Crisp editorial line art, single subject centered on plain unmarked cream paper.
styles.D_riso: {S}, as a two-color risograph print in deep navy blue and warm red ink, grainy halftone texture, slight misregistration, bold simple shapes. Single subject centered on plain unmarked cream paper.
styles.E_gouache: {S}, painted in gouache and ink in a mid-century editorial magazine style, muted palette of navy, brick red, mustard and cream, confident brush texture with fine ink outlines. Single subject centered on plain unmarked cream paper.
